selection_principle: Representative cases selected by predefined quantitative criteria before visualization; no manual visual cherry-picking.

distant_success.selection_rule: 40-60 m valid Moderate Car; IoU >= 0.70; highest 3D IoU.

distant_localisation_near_miss.selection_rule: 40-60 m valid Moderate Car; 0.50 <= IoU < 0.70; highest prediction confidence.

high_confidence_unmatched.selection_rule: Score >= 0.50; no 3D overlap with evaluated or ignored Moderate GT; highest confidence.
high_confidence_unmatched.caution: Diagnostic unmatched prediction only; not labelled as an official KITTI false positive.
